---
vault_path: .
# Archive/ is not one of the user's notes, but it is still a real file a link
# may point at -- which is what makes it a valid repair destination.
exclude:
  - Archive
---

# Repair

A vault carrying the links that break while knapper is not looking: paths that
went stale when a folder was reorganised elsewhere, an encoding that survived a
round trip, and the ones no filesystem can settle.
